name: readout-wall
description: The measurement wall of indefinite causal order, executed as an exchange-rate ledger. The ledger's #06 cost column cites three walls; the first — 'readout collapses the order' — has been quoted in every repo since switch-sched but never executed as its own object. This repo is that execution: the collapse identity (dephasing the order register leaves exactly the classical mixture of the fixed-order channels — machine-checked to 1e-12 across random CPTP pairs and the showcase families), the ESC18 exchange (the 0.048795 bits of the two-depolarizing switch live entirely in the off-block coherences; a z-readout of the order kills exactly that and leaves 0, while the order bit it buys is input-blind — a fair coin about the branch, never about the payload), the complementarity face (the replacer pair parks its information ON the control at x-coherence; reading the order basis sees nothing), the partial-readout interpolation curve (data, no convexity theorem claimed), and the k=3 face where the wall scales to six orders. Every ledger row is an exchange: what you GET | what you PAY. The checker enforces the exchange laws — a one-sided trade, an EXACT tag without a passing witness, or a dead anchor all fail the build.
